dj.line:
Fee of 8388608 isn't a number, it's a raised eyebrow — that bit flags the house to reach into the pot mid-hand and re-cut the rake whenever it likes. You sit down thinking the odds are printed on the felt, but the felt is being re-stitched under your elbows.

So — when the rake moves and the cards were already dealt, who exactly is holding the deck?
